data.name: Pidilite Industries Ltd
data.about: Pidilite Industries Limited is a leading manufacturer of adhesives and sealants, construction chemicals, craftsmen products, DIY  products and polymer emulsions in India. Most of the products have been developed through strong in-house R&D. Our brand name Fevicol has become synonymous with adhesives to millions in India and is ranked amongst the most trusted brands in the country. Some of our other major brands are M-Seal, Fevikwik, Fevistik, Roff, Dr. Fixit, Fevicryl, Motomax, Hobby Ideas, Araldite.[1]

data.what_it_does: Pidilite sells a wide range of adhesives, sealants, art & craft materials, construction chemicals, and paint chemicals under its Branded Consumer & Bazaar segment to households, students, carpenters, painters, plumbers, mechanics, and offices. Its Business-to-Business segment supplies industrial adhesives, industrial resins, construction chemicals, organic pigments, and pigment preparations to industries including packaging, textiles, paints, printing inks, paper, and leather.

bull.text: PAT grew at a 24.2% 3-year CAGR versus 7.4% revenue CAGR, driving operating margin expansion from 16.8% to 24.1% and a 31% ROCE.
Management delivered on its 20-24% operating margin guidance, achieving 24.1% for four consecutive quarters.
The balance sheet shows minimal leverage with a debt-to-equity of 0.04 and strong cash conversion with operating cash flow to PAT of 1.24 over three years.

bear.text: Revenue growth is modest at a 7.4% 3-year CAGR, indicating limited top-line momentum.
Return on equity is not reported (n/a), making it difficult to assess shareholder returns.
Revenue is heavily concentrated in the Branded Consumer & Bazaar segment at 81.6%, creating segment concentration risk.
